[[Bauer's Intimidation]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] obtained from [[Grahame]] in [[Lion's Arch Keep]] after completion of [[The Battle for Lion's Arch]] in exchange for 10 [[Medal of Honor|Medals of Honor]]. As the name would suggest, this focus is a replica of the one [[Inquisitor Bauer]] wields.

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Death Magic]])
:[[Death Magic]] +1 (Chance: 20% while using skills)
:[[Health]] +30 

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, an exact technical replica for this item is the [[Bleached Skull]] from collectors [[Dai Waeng]] or [[Dmitri Scharkoff]], or crafter [[Sheco]].
